description: Create a Word document with rich Markdown, tables, code blocks, links, images, optional Portal theme, and optional PDF export
name: create_word_document

images.description: Images with source/path_or_url, optional caption and width_in

template.description: Style template name, for example portal

also_pdf.description: Also export PDF using host LibreOffice

description: Create a PowerPoint presentation with optional per-slide charts/images, Portal theme, and PDF export
name: create_powerpoint

template.description: Style template name, for example portal

also_pdf.description: Also export PDF using host LibreOffice

description: Create an Excel spreadsheet with optional native bar, line, or pie charts and PDF export
name: create_excel

sheets.description: Multiple sheets with name, headers, and rows

also_pdf.description: Also export PDF using host LibreOffice

description: Convert between document formats using host LibreOffice
name: convert_document

description: Export a generated Office document to PDF. Requires LibreOffice on the host and returns a clear error when unavailable.
name: export_pdf

source_path.description: Path to a generated Office document

description: Prepare a media/image URL for embedding in create_word_document images or a create_powerpoint slide's images list
name: prepare_embed_image

description: List recently generated documents in the output directory. Use this to find files created by other tools.
name: list_generated_files

description: Extract text content and structure from an existing Word (.docx) file. Returns headings, paragraphs, and table data.
name: read_word_document

file_path.description: Absolute path to the .docx file to read

include_tables.description: Whether to include table cell content (default true)

description: Extract data from an existing Excel (.xlsx) spreadsheet. Returns sheet names and row data for each sheet.
name: read_excel

file_path.description: Absolute path to the .xlsx file to read

max_rows.description: Maximum rows to return per sheet (default 500)

description: Extract text and speaker notes from an existing PowerPoint (.pptx) file. Returns slide titles, content, and notes.
name: read_powerpoint

file_path.description: Absolute path to the .pptx file to read

description: Extract text content from an existing PDF file page by page. Also extracts tables when present. Requires pdfplumber.
name: read_pdf

file_path.description: Absolute path to the .pdf file to read

include_tables.description: Whether to extract table data alongside text (default true)
